draft.subject: Re: A few days into Wrenfield -- how's it going?
draft.body:
Hi Victor,

Understood -- take the time you need to decide, and I won't crowd your week. Tariq closed the loop on your bulk import question: teammates can be bulk-invited from a CSV file instead of one at a time, and a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

You've already got your first project set up, and projects are the main organizing unit, with tasks living inside them. If it would help your evaluation, I'm happy to hop on a short call this week to walk through how your team would use it day to day -- otherwise I'll check back next week.

Best,
Nadia
